narrative_hook: You're graduating from managing single pieces of data to organizing entire inventories of complex items.
title: The Digital Inventory: Mastering Arrays of Objects

narrative_hook: Sometimes data is so complex it needs its own internal organization, like a user profile with a nested address object.
title: The Organizer's Desk: Structuring Nested Data

narrative_hook: Learn to package your complex data into JSON, the universal format for exchanging information between web systems.
title: The Data Passport: Speaking the Language of APIs

narrative_hook: Elevate your skills by learning how to use functions as tools to operate on other functions, unlocking incredible power.
title: The Master Key: Unlocking Higher-Order Functions

narrative_hook: Instead of manually looping to change a list, use the `.map()` method to transform an entire dataset in one clean step.
title: The Transformer: Reshaping Data with .map()

title: The Precision Sieve: Finding Data with .filter()
